title: Task records ride in slice PRs, never their own PR; audit skips tasks/
body:
Source: operator-forwarded weekly process review, 2026-11-19.
Evidence: measured over 7 days on origin/main (.krn/runs/arch-review/metrics.md): 144 chore(tasks) commits, and 84 of the last 300 merged PRs were chore(tasks). tasks/ held 9.4% of changed lines, not the 45% in the review. The records-only PRs are still noise in audit and review.
Files: src/task/ (publish), src/ci/ship.ts, docs/program/repository-workflow.md
Outcome: pending task records ride in the next slice PR that ship opens; a records-only publish happens at most once a day; audit and review tooling skips tasks/.
Proof: a ship test shows pending records land in the slice PR; a publish test refuses a second records-only PR within a day.
